theorem SigmaCompact.exists_compact_trap.{u, v} {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Type v} [(i : ι) → TopologicalSpace (X i)]
  (b : (i : ι) → X i) [∀ (i : ι), T1Space (X i)] (hX : ∀ (i : ι), SigmaCompact.OmegaBounded (X i))
  {s : Set ((i : ι) → X i)} (hs : Set.Countable s)
  (hsupp : ∀ (x : (i : ι) → X i), Membership.mem s x → Set.Countable (SigmaCompact.deviationSupport b x)) :
  Exists fun J =>
    Exists fun K =>
      And (Set.Countable J)
        (And (IsClosed K)
          (And (IsCompact K)
            (And (LE.le (closure s) K)
              (∀ (x : (i : ι) → X i), Membership.mem K x → LE.le (SigmaCompact.deviationSupport b x) J))))

surface.module_doc:
# Compact closures in countable-support products

The product topology and its canonical subtype topology are used throughout.
The omega-bounded theorem assumes T1 factors, not first countability or
compactness. The compactness criterion assumes compact Hausdorff factors.
